free_tier.stated: Reported tiers for maintainers of public, OSI-licensed projects: Starter at USD 50 to 150 per month for 3 months at roughly 100 to 1,000 stars, Growth at USD 150 to 400 per month for 3 months, and Flagship at USD 400 to 1,500 per month renewed monthly. Reported by a third-party perks directory and by a project maintainer's GitHub discussion post.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A monthly renewed inference credit is the only recurring shape found in this class, and it composes with an existing public project rather than requiring a new one. Where it breaks: it buys inference on a reseller's catalogue, not GPU time, and the renewal is at the vendor's discretion.
